text:
In June 2026 the Mettmann district recorded median asking rents of 10.8 €/m², up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the past five years, placing it 22nd among the 37 most expensive German cities. The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and an average of 29 days on market; 24 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is moderate: the rent for a 60 m² unit is 648 €/month, generating a rent‑burden of 12.5 % for two residents, while asking rents sit 50 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 7.21 €/m².

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 11.0 – 11.56 €/m², implying a further 4.7 % increase.
